children: Our bureau Mumbai: Air India and Air India Express have extended flight suspensions to Saudi Arabia amid continuing security concerns in the Middle East, following similar extensions announced by IndiGo and Akasa Air on Friday.

In its latest advisory on Saturday, Air India said flights to and from Riyadh and Dammam would remain suspended until November 7, while services to and from Jeddah would remain cancelled until October 31. Passengers with eligible bookings can opt for flexible rebooking or a full refund. Both airlines are also offering one-time complimentary rebooking on operational routes, subject to availability and specified travel deadlines.

title: AI, AI Express Extend Saudi Flight Curbs
